filing: the quarterly report identified by {accession}, form {form}, for the period ended {period_end}, read at the cutoff {cutoff}
purpose: bear, base and bull drivers for a ten-year discounted cash flow; every driver is a decimal, and every reason rests on a verbatim quote or on calculator fields
author: single-agent control (one agent, no reader or analyst layers)

shared.terminal_growth_ceiling: terminal growth in every scenario is held at or below the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value}
shared.reinvestment_definition: net capital expenditure plus the change in trade working capital plus acquisitions, as a share of after-tax operating income; depreciation and amortization are untagged for the period ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}), so the rates below are set on the gross capital expenditure {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}, the rise in trade working capital from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier.value} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now.value}, and acquisitions of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value}, with judgment for the untagged depreciation offset

cross_scenario_notes: Operating margin in every scenario is a GAAP margin including share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} and recurring restructuring; no non-GAAP add-backs are assumed.
Other income from Level three investment gains and any tariff refund are excluded from operating margin in every scenario; they are non-operating.

The starting invested capital {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.invested_capital.value} nets out cash and investments and includes operating leases, consistent with the calculator; inventory purchase commitments are not capitalized because they are untagged and will become inventory as they are honored.

Because depreciation and amortization are untagged for the period, reinvestment rates are judgments anchored on gross capital expenditure and the working-capital change rather than computed net figures; a valuation run should recompute them once the annual report tags the year.
Terminal growth never exceeds the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value}; the bull sits below it by design.
limits: This is a single-agent control: the drivers were set by the same agent that wrote the accounting and financial analyses, with no separate valuation analyst to challenge them.
No earnings-release current report body or management guidance is on record before the cutoff, so revenue and margin drivers rest on the quarterly report alone.

Depreciation and amortization are missing from the calculator for the current year to date, so free cash flow to the firm and net reinvestment could not be computed; the reinvestment rates are set with judgment on gross figures.
The customer-concentration facts are empty in the calculator, so the dependence on service-provider and cloud customers is inferred from prose.
The trend table lacks fiscal fourth quarters and most MD&A paragraphs are marked unchanged and not reproduced, which limits the view of seasonality and of management's longer discussion.
There are no prior predictions for this company against which to calibrate the scenarios.
